games.cq.rules.familia: Familia (3 or 4 players): two decks, 9 cards each, lay down 10. First, everyone passes one card to the left (the Cambio).
games.cq.rules.force: If the card fits one of the next player's melds, you can make them take it. Fun to do, sad to get.
games.cq.rules.goal: Be the first to lay down all your cards in melds: 11 in Classic (your 10, plus one you take), 10 in Familia.
games.cq.rules.last_one: All your cards down but one short? Then you wait for one more card that fits your melds.
games.cq.rules.step_1: A card is turned up in the middle. You never pick cards up into your hand.
games.cq.rules.step_2: If it's offered to you, take it only if it goes straight into a meld (¡Me sirve!). You can also move your own melds around.
games.cq.rules.step_3: Then throw one card away. It's offered to the next player.
games.cq.rules.step_4: Nobody wants it? It's dead, and the next card is turned up.

games.rules.market: A full Line (6 in a run or 4 colours) goes into the **Bag**. At turn end, the **Market** opens at most once per lap. Offer 1–3 cards: matching counts swap blind. No match? Swap with the Bag. Everyone taps **Done!** to close.
games.rules.spark: **Spark** = any card. A Line needs a real card. Take a Spark back with the exact card (any missing colour in a group); play the Spark again this turn.
games.rules.step_1: Refill your **hand to 7 cards** from the Bag.
games.rules.step_2: Make **Lines**: one colour in order, 3–6 cards within 1–12; or one number in 3–4 different colours.
games.rules.step_3: Play your **Stack's top card**, then flip the next. Keep playing as much as you like.
games.rules.step_4: Move table cards if every card stays on the table and every Line is good when you **Place**. Simple table: only add or start Lines.
games.rules.step_5: Tap **Done**. Played no card this turn? Draw **2** (hand limit 12).
games.rules.stuck: **Swap & pass**: swap your Stack top with a hand card. You may Place once more, then your turn ends. Empty your Stack to win; winner scores 5 × others' remaining Stack cards (minimum 10), match to 100. Empty Bag and a lap with no play? Smallest Stack wins; ties share.
